### Bible Pathways 02/12/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-02-or-12-or-2002-1127444.html
Passage: Numbers 1:19
Points:
- God gave detailed commands for organizing Israel and expects complete obedience in daily life.
- Moses obediently counted every qualified male aged twenty and older in the Sinai wilderness.
- An entire generation wasted thirty-eight years in the desert because fear and unbelief kept them from trusting God.
- Believers fall into spiritual stagnation when they complain about circumstances or blame God for unmet expectations.
- Enduring trials with faith and contentment allows Christians to overcome obstacles through Christ's strength.
